description: Agent-direct upload, no human step. 1: get_media_upload_url({ domain, filename, content_type, size_bytes? }) returns { asset_id, upload_url, public_url, expires_in }. 2: HTTP PUT the raw bytes to upload_url with a matching Content-Type. 3: finalize_media_upload({ asset_id, domain }). For bytes with no public URL, or too big for upload_media URL mode (e.g. video over 200 MB). If the PUT fails with a network error (sandboxed or proxied agent), use upload_media interactive mode instead. Allowed: images, mp4/webm/quicktime, pdf, mp3/wav. Max 20 MB images, 50 MB PDF, 1 GB video. URL expires after expires_in seconds.

content_type.description: MIME type you will PUT the bytes with, e.g. video/mp4. Must match the upload.

domain.description: Site domain whose media library receives the file (e.g. example.com).

filename.description: File name to store, with extension (e.g. demo.mp4).

kind.description: Library category for the asset. Defaults to "mcp-upload".

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes, if known.

title.description: Title for the asset in the media library.

name: get_media_upload_url
title: Get Media Upload URL
